observations: The first memory substep closes the strict mass gate.
The second substep is reported converged by MODFLOW after two iterations but is about 3.33e-9 m below the analytic head.
That head error maps to about 6.67e-10 m storage error, much larger than the pre-registered 1e-12 m mass tolerance.
The failure therefore demonstrates that subsystem solver convergence can be insufficient for a stricter coupled mass-conservation requirement.
